product_one_liner.value: Trackforce unifies physical-security patrols, incident reporting, scheduling and billing for guarding companies and enterprise security teams.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes selectable modules and custom quotes based on sites, team and modules, but publishes no numeric rates.

employee_band.notes: Inc.'s company profile lists this size band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents security-operations guidance and product/marketing content, rather than an engineering-authored product-build blog.

public_docs.notes: The public TrackTik Help Center contains product guides, developer/API tools and multiple release-note articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists Enterprise Sales Director – NORAM and Major Accounts Account Manager; neither title qualifies.

model_provider.notes: No specific AI model or inference provider was disclosed in the reviewed product documentation, AI policy, product page, blog/press coverage or subprocessor list; AWS references concern hosting and storage.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR is a compliance claim, not an independent certification.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights reports a $0.37M Series B from Georgian on July 27, 2023. No primary announcement was located; Tracxn's funding history lists only older rounds ending in September 2019.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round listed by CB Insights is July 27, 2023, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive – Mid Market SaaS Security Workforce Management Software posting includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: August 2026 release notes introduce missed-tour detection, a new Missed status and Missed Tour Alerts.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Trackforce announced Scott Kaine's appointment as CEO on January 12, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Salesforce Systems Administrator posting explicitly names integrations across this sales and marketing stack.
